title: Flat local map on a prepared Popescu chart
statement: Let R and Cbar be commutative rings, pi in R, and compatible algebra structures R to Cbar and R/pi^2 to Cbar. Let d be prepared finite polynomial data [lem-weil-pbc-popescu-lift-preparation]: P=R[x_1,...,x_n], finitely many f_l, a_k, subsets E_k, coefficients h_{klj}, g_{kl}, and a surjection epsilon:(R/pi^2)[x] to Cbar with the prescribed kernel, smooth charts, conormal and differential bases, normalized coefficients and cleared relations. Put Q=P[z_1,...,z_m], u_l=f_l-pi z_l, p_{kl}=a_k z_l-sum_{j in E_k}h_{klj}z_j-pi g_{kl}, D=ULift(Q/(u_l,p_{kl})), and D_0=D/pi D. Let c:Cbar to D_0 be an R-algebra map taking epsilon(X_i) to the original generator x_i of D_0. Fix a prime q of D_0 and a chart k with c(epsilon(reduced(a_k))) outside q. Put qD equal to the inverse image of q in D, and p equal to its contraction to R. Assume R is Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] and Ann_R(pi)=Ann_R(pi^2). Then the canonical local ring map R_p to D_{qD} [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime] is flat [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map]. No smoothness conclusion is asserted.

proof.text: Define D_k=Q/(u_j for j in E_k, p_{kl} for l outside E_k), using the same polynomials as the explicit lifting algebra D. This is n+m variables modulo m relations because normalization makes p_{kl}=0 for l in E_k. There is a surjection D_k to D. Extend hc from variables to polynomial values using the scalar tower and polynomial extensionality. Thus a_k avoids q_k, the inverse image of qD, and pi belongs to q_k.

proof.text: Modulo pi and after inverting a_k, the cleared relations identify the coefficient quotient with (Cbar/pi Cbar)_{a_k}; solving for complementary z_l identifies (D_k/pi D_k)_{a_k} with its polynomial algebra in |E_k| variables. Prepared.smooth and its differential basis, base change of smoothness and differentials, and polynomial differential decomposition give a smooth residue-field fibre with differential rank (n-|E_k|)+|E_k|=n. Differential rank equals topologicalKrullDimAt at the fibre prime, the dimension of the spectrum at the point rather than the Krull dimension of its local ring.

proof.text: Apply the equation-count flatness theorem with n+m variables, m equations and dimension n. It gives Module.Flat R (D_k)_{q_k}.

proof.text: The cleared relation gives pi p_{kl}=-a_k u_l+sum_{j in E_k}h_{klj}u_j. In D_k, p_{kl}=0 and u_j=0 for j in E_k. Since a_k is a unit in (D_k)_{a_k}, every u_l is zero there.

source.place: Stacks Project, Tag 07CP (lemma-lifting), https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/07CP; read from the online tag because the local TeX is absent.

proof.text: For k prime and j in E_k, the two expressions for a_k a_{k prime} f_l give the conormal relation with coefficients b_j=a_{k prime}h_{klj}-sum_{j prime in E_{k prime}}h_{k prime,l,j prime}h_{k,j prime,j}. Basis independence makes these coefficients zero in Cbar_{a_k}. Clear denominators to put a power of a_k times b_j in I+pi^2P. The cleared relations give a_k I contained in I_{E_k}+pi^2P, so one more power puts the same coefficients in I_{E_k}+pi^2P. Expanding the p relations now puts p_{k prime,l} in pi(D_k)_{a_k}, since all f_j for j in E_k equal pi z_j there. The key identity also gives pi p_{k prime,l}=0.

source.place: Stacks Project, Tag 07CP (lemma-lifting), https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/07CP; read from the online tag because the local TeX is absent.

proof.text: In the flat local ring T=(D_k)_{q_k}, apply flat base change of annihilators to pi and pi^2. The assumed equality over R gives Ann_T(pi)=Ann_T(pi^2). Write the image of p_{k prime,l} as pi y. Its product by pi is zero, so pi^2 y=0, hence pi y=0. All generators of the kernel of D_k to D vanish in T. Localizing the surjection at q_k and qD is therefore a bijection of local rings compatible with R.

source.place: Stacks Project, Tag 07CP (lemma-lifting), https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/07CP; read from the online tag because the local TeX is absent.

proof.text: Transport Module.Flat R T along the induced R-algebra equivalence T to D_{qD}. To localize the base from R to R_p, use Module.flat_iff_of_isLocalization for p.primeCompl; the elements of R outside p are units in D_{qD}. This gives exactly flatness of the canonical localRingHom R_p to D_{qD}. No finite-kernel neighbourhood is needed.

theorem popescu_lift_chart_flat (R : Type a) (Cbar : Type c)
    [CommRing R] [CommRing Cbar] [Algebra R Cbar] [IsNoetherianRing R] (π : R)
    [Algebra (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({π ^ 2} : Set R)) Cbar]
    [IsScalarTower R (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({π ^ 2} : Set R)) Cbar]
    (d : PopescuLiftPresentation R Cbar π) (hd : d.Prepared)
    (hAnnR : Module.annihilator R (Ideal.span ({π} : Set R)) =
      Module.annihilator R (Ideal.span ({π ^ 2} : Set R)))
    (c : Cbar →ₐ[R] (d.liftingAlgebra ⧸
      Ideal.span ({algebraMap R d.liftingAlgebra π} : Set d.liftingAlgebra)))
    (hc : ∀ i : Fin d.n, c (d.ε (MvPolynomial.X i)) = Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (d.x i))
    (q : PrimeSpectrum (d.liftingAlgebra ⧸
      Ideal.span ({algebraMap R d.liftingAlgebra π} : Set d.liftingAlgebra)))
    (k : Fin d.r) (hk : c (d.ε (d.reduced (d.a k))) ∉ q.asIdeal) :
    let qD := PrimeSpectrum.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk _) q
    (Localization.localRingHom (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap R d.liftingAlgebra) qD).asIdeal
      qD.asIdeal (algebraMap R d.liftingAlgebra) rfl).Flat
